name: mleha-hermes
description: Read-only tools for the Hermes assistant over the Mleha store API. No tool can change data.

authentication.note: Credentials live in the Hermes gateway secret store, one per audience. None are included here.

error_handling.401: Credential problem; stop and alert an operator.
error_handling.403: Tell the employee the request needs a manager; do not retry with other tools.
error_handling.404: Say nothing was found; do not try other identifiers on the customer's behalf.

tools.name: find_order
tools.description: Find a customer's orders using exactly ONE full identifier the customer gave: order number, phone number, email, or shipment tracking number. Never guess or iterate identifiers. Returns compact order summaries; call get_order for details.

order_number.description: Customer-facing order number. Arabic-Indic digits, '#', spaces and dashes are normalised.

phone.description: Full phone number; normalised to E.164 (Saudi 05xxxxxxxx accepted). No partial matching.

email.description: Full email address; case-insensitive exact match.

tracking_number.description: Exact carrier or local tracking number.

tools.display_rules: May be shown to support staff and managers. Phone is masked for support credentials; do not try to reconstruct it.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Full support view of one order: status timeline, payment and fulfillment state, items with variants and prices, discounts, shipping charge, totals, shipments with tracking links, returns and refunds. Use the order_reference from find_order or from the customer.
tools.pii_classification: customer_contact_masked; street address only with hermes:manager:pii
tools.display_rules: May be shown to support staff and managers. Never read out discounts' internal codes as promises of future discounts.

tools.name: find_customer
tools.description: Find a customer by exactly ONE full identifier: phone, email or Salla customer id. Returns at most 5 matches with an opaque customer_ref for get_customer_summary. Browsing or listing customers is not possible.

phone.description: Full phone number; normalised to E.164 (Saudi 05xxxxxxxx accepted). No partial matching.

email.description: Full email address; case-insensitive exact match.

tools.display_rules: May be shown to support staff and managers.

tools.name: get_customer_summary
tools.description: Support summary for one customer: order count, recent and active orders, active shipments, returns. customerRef must come from find_customer or an order response; it cannot be constructed.
tools.display_rules: May be shown to support staff and managers.

tools.name: find_shipment
tools.description: List shipments for an order number or a tracking number, with normalized status, carrier, tracking link, ship/delivery dates and any delivery exception.

order_number.description: Customer-facing order number. Arabic-Indic digits, '#', spaces and dashes are normalised.

tracking_number.description: Exact carrier or local tracking number.

tools.display_rules: May be shown to support staff and managers.

tools.name: get_shipment
tools.description: One shipment by tracking number with its public tracking events (label, warehouse dispatch, carrier scans, local courier delivery).
tools.display_rules: May be shown to support staff and managers.

tools.name: get_sales_report
tools.description: Sales summary in SAR for a date range (max 92 days): gross and net sales, order count, average order value, discounts, shipping revenue, refunds, VAT, with optional comparison to the previous period or year. Always quote meta.definitions when explaining a figure.

to.description: Last local date (inclusive). Range at most 92 days.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used for date boundaries.

status.description: Comma-separated normalized order statuses: awaiting_payment, new, processing, ready_to_ship, shipped, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled, return_in_progress, returned, deleted, other.

payment_method.description: Comma-separated Salla payment method slugs, e.g. mada,cod,tabby_installment.

carrier.description: Comma-separated carriers: smsa, ajex, dhl, aramex, redbox, fedex, ups, local_courier, other.

page_size.description: Max 100; applies to every detailed list in the report.

tools.display_rules: Managers only. Never expose to support staff or customers; the API also refuses support credentials with 403.
